hints: A positron carries positive unit charge but zero nucleon number.
walkthrough: Conserving charge gives the daughter proton number 18 − 1 = 17. The nucleon number remains 35.

hints: Identify the neutral lepton produced with a positron.
Both down and strange quarks have the same negative fractional charge.
walkthrough: Each down quark and each strange quark has charge $-e/3$.
